text:
maya: quick heads-up — QA hit a parser/runtime mismatch in the SLO expression editor when combining rolling windows + tenant filters. expression parses in the UI but the API returns 400 on save :confused:

eli: can you paste the failing expression and the error from the API?

maya: sure — repro snippet:
```
error_rate(service:\"ingest\", window=5m) > 0.03 and tenant in (\"acme\", \"beta\")
```
API reply: `400 Bad Request - invalid threshold expression: unresolved identifier 'tenant' in compiled plan`

samir: hmm, looks like the UI lets the `tenant` name be used in the local AST but the backend only supports `labels.tenant` in the current parser. we changed the API contract last quarter when adding label scoping and forgot to sync the editor aliases.

jess: ugh. that explains a few customer reports about silent rejections. two immediate concerns: 1) UX should show runtime validation before save, 2) we need a compatibility shim so older expressions don't break existing SLOs.

eli: +1. For (1) can we wire the editor to call the new /validate endpoint on blur/save? returns (ok|errors) and a small preview of matched series. sample response: `{ok:true, examples: 12}`. we could show a yellow warning if examples==0.

samir: agree on validate call. for the shim we can accept legacy aliases server-side and emit a deprecation warning in audit logs. low risk and buys time for UX migration.

maya: UX ask: show a compact humanized preview of the compiled expression (the parsed canonical form) under the editor, e.g. `labels.service==ingest && rate_5m(error_rate)>0.03 && labels.tenant in [acme,beta]`. that would make backend errors obvious to product owners.

jess: also we need mapping from expression severity -> notify routing. today the editor exposes a dropdown (low/med/high) but backend uses numeric priority (1-5). we should show the numeric mapping inline and let users edit both. otherwise alert routing surprises ops.

eli: good call. API change idea: return `severityHints:{name: \"high\", priority: 4, recommended_channels: [\"pager\",\"email\"]}` in the validate response. UI can render that next to the severity control.

ops-bot: deploy 2024-07-18T18:45:12Z: /api/slo/validate deployed to canary (region-us-west). :rocket:

samir: telemetry request — please add trace id and parse-time metrics to the validation endpoint response when running in canary. we need to capture parse duration, rewrite count, and whether alias-shim was applied. this will help tune the parser and measure compatibility breakage.

maya: also ask from QA: include a \"match preview\" toggle that samples a tenant's recent 5 min windows and highlights which tenants would fire. helps catch accidental globbing.

jess: rollout plan proposal:
- canary validate endpoint (ops-bot did) + server-side alias shim
- UI: wire validate on blur + show canonical preview + numeric severity hint (A/B test with 10% orgs)
- telemetry for parse/shim/match-counts
- deprecation modal when user edits an expression using legacy alias (30d before hard error)

eli: I'll own the API validate change and telemetry. samir will add alias shim and audit warnings. maya/jess will design the preview + severity mapping UI. QA to run tenant-sampled match checks.

maya: thanks — I'll add the action items to the SLO editor ticket and drop a small mock in #devex later. :thumbsup:
